title: Computational Compliance for AI Regulation: Blueprint for a New Research Domain
reasoning: The paper focuses on creating a framework for automated, computational legal compliance with AI regulations. While laws encode "societal values" and the paper briefly mentions "ethical considerations", its primary objective is not to evaluate or benchmark ethics, morals, or faith. The core proposal is technical and legal, centered on verifying adherence to specific, codified regulations rather than assessing broader ethical principles.
